decision.reason: D([A,B]) equals the prefix difference S_O(B)-S_O(A-1), so the classical |S_O(N)| << N^{5/6} bound yields only a location-dependent majorant << B^{5/6}. That is not a transfer theorem and is not |I|-uniform: a monochromatic run of length 52 on [952525,952627] has |D|=#odds. The expanding image Y=J_O(O(I)) is strictly increasing and highly fragmented, so the interval theorem does not apply to Y. Witness: Y of [1000,1099] has 25 odd points and |D(Y)|/#odd(Y)=0.36. 19 odd-images with at least 20 odd points concentrate at level 0.25; 12 diagnostic J^2 samples do as well. Interval cancellation does not survive Juggler-generated sets in a useful uniform form.
